description.narrative:
PLEASE REVIEW YOUR ANSWER AS THE QUESTION HAS BEEN CHANGED
PricewaterhouseCoopers har valts ut genom ett avropsavtal för att genomföra en verifiering av Somalias gemensamma humanitära fond (CHF). Den föreslagna budgeten är cirka 23 000 USD. Verifierings syfte är att kontrollera CHF:s processer och kontrollsystem för att säkerställa att det svenska bidraget använts på rätt sätt och att CHF har adekvata finansiella system och uppföljningsmekanismer.

Sweden and OCHA have agreed that Sweden will carry out a verification assessment of the current risk-management system within CHF Somalia. This verification assessment aims at assessing and analysing whether the CHF risk-management and monitoring systems are adequate to ensure accountable and effective management of the funds. The consultant, Waterpricehouse Coopers is expected to give an overall assessment of the system in place, highlight areas for improvement and make concrete recommendations to the CHF advisory board. Based on the findings, Sweden will require that the CHF Somalia addresses the findings and recommendations in a management response. The findings will also provide Sweden with relevant information when deciding on further support to CHF Somalia. The assignment shall begin no later than 2014-05-26 and the final report shall be proof read and submitted to Sida no later than 2014-06-23.
